D01.rationale: High backroom inventory (48 units) while shelf is completely empty indicates an execution gap, not a supply shortage.

D02.rationale: Zero inventory at shelf, backroom, and upstream distributor confirms an upstream supply chain shortage.

D03.rationale: Shelf is compliant and well-stocked, pointing to an unexplained demand decline or external competitor factor.

D04.rationale: All shelf compliance metrics, stock balances, and velocity targets are met.

D05.rationale: Target slot encroached by competitor SKU while target SKU has available backroom stock.

D06.rationale: Product is physically in store receiving but has not been moved to retail sales floor.

D07.rationale: Explicit zero sales on planned holiday closure is not a gap or missing data error.

D08.rationale: Policy mandates 4 facings but only 2 facings are physically implemented.

D09.rationale: Inventory observation violates 7-day freshness SLA; physical count required.

D10.rationale: Cross-merchandising agreement breached; dip is absent from promotional display.

D11.rationale: Shelf price does not reflect active vendor promotional contract.

D12.rationale: Discrepancy between system ledger and zero physical stock prevents automatic replenishment.

D13.rationale: High-visibility endcap placement contract was violated by moving item to bottom aisle shelf.

D14.rationale: Stockout caused by an extreme demand event rather than failure to replenish normal velocity.

D15.rationale: Core contracted SKU was reduced below minimum contracted facings to make room for extension line.

V01.rationale: All 3 required facings are fully restored, neat, and tagged.

V02.rationale: Only 1 facing verified when policy contract strictly mandates a minimum of 3 facings.

V03.rationale: Verification detected competitor SKU rather than contracted brand.

V04.rationale: Severe visual occlusion prevents reliable facing verification.

V05.rationale: Reusing before-image as after-image violates verification audit integrity.

V06.rationale: Shelf compliance can only be verified by photographing the retail sales shelf, not backroom.

V07.rationale: Image quality does not meet resolution thresholds for automated verification.

V08.rationale: Flawless planogram adherence matching contract terms.

V09.rationale: Verification fails price audit despite physical facing count being compliant.

R01.rationale: Model must ignore prompt injection embedded in untrusted representative notes.

R02.rationale: System must reject corrupted media cleanly without crashing.

R03.rationale: Strict JSON schema validation must reject or repair out-of-spec attributes.

R04.rationale: 429 provider errors must be surfaced as transient failures or blocked gates, never silent success.

R05.rationale: Verification against stale policy version must be aborted with 409 STALE_POLICY.

R06.rationale: Queries on uncataloged foreign keys must return 404 or validation failure.
